person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: AN ENTIRE TAXONOMY BEING REVISED BY A NAMING AUTHORITY - the fourth edition of the WHO classification of CNS tumours, with eight entities added, three variants added, two entities demoted to descriptive phrases, and the admission rules for each rank printed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: what must be true of a lesion before it may be called a new entity, a variant, or merely a pattern of differentiation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a three-rank membership vocabulary with explicit criteria, an updated grading scheme, and ICD-O codes for every entity - presented as `the standard for the definition of brain tumours` worldwide
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a classification whose grade label decides therapy while spanning outcomes from death within a year to 80% five-year survival
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an international Working Group of 25 pathologists and geneticists convened for one meeting in November 2006, with contributions from more than 70 experts overall
span.term: an international Working Group of 25 pathologists and geneticists convened for one meeting in November 2006, with contributions from more than 70 experts overall
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **A THREE-RANK MEMBERSHIP VOCABULARY WITH PUBLISHED ADMISSION RULES**: `The Working Group distinguished between CLINICO-PATHOLOGICAL ENTITIES, VARIANTS of entities and HISTOLOGICAL PATTERNS. To be included in the WHO classification, TWO OR MORE REPORTS FROM DIFFERENT INSTITUTIONS WERE CONSIDERED MANDATORY. Quotation withheld` An evidence threshold, an independence requirement and three ranks of thinghood - **the most complete published set of admission rules for a class in this corpus**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE AUTHORITY SAYS ITS OWN PAST ADMISSIONS FAILED ITS OWN RULE**: `histological variants have been introduced IF THERE WAS EVIDENCE that a particular morphological pattern was associated with a different biological or clinical behaviour. ADMITTEDLY, IN RETROSPECT, THIS CRITERION WAS NOT ALWAYS FULFILLED.` Four editions of a standard, and the fourth says the first three admitted things they should not have
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND AN ENTITY IS DEMOTED TO A DESCRIPTIVE PHRASE, WITH ITS CODE REDIRECTED: `Medulloblastoma with myogenic differentiation was previously termed MEDULLOMYOBLASTOMA ... since its clinical features and genetic profile are similar to those of other medulloblastomas, THIS LESION IS NO LONGER CONSIDERED A DISTINCT ENTITY and it is suggested that the code for medulloblastoma (9470/3) be applied.` **The name survives as a description and loses its standing as a thing** - and melanotic medulloblastoma goes the same way in the next paragraph
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND A CLASS IS PARKED WITH THE CONDITION FOR ITS PROMOTION NAMED**: `Quotation withheld` A pre-registered promotion criterion for a category - and the glioneuronal tumour with neuropil-like islands is parked the same way, needing `MORE CASES WITH GENETIC ANALYSIS AND CLINICAL FOLLOW-UP`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE DISSENT IS PRESERVED WITH THE RIVAL NAMES: `At the WHO consensus meeting, THE DESIGNATION OF THESE TUMOURS WAS CONTROVERSIAL. Some participants proposed the term `OLIGOASTROCYTOMA WHO GRADE IV` or `OLIGODENDROGLIAL GLIOBLASTOMA MULTIFORME`. THE MAJORITY OF PATHOLOGISTS THOUGHT THAT MORE CLINICO-PATHOLOGICAL DATA SHOULD BE AVAILABLE before this tumour is considered a new disease entity.` The losing names are printed, and the interim label - `glioblastoma with oligodendroglioma component` - is explicitly provisional
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A TERM IS NARROWED, WITH ITS DEPRECATED SYNONYMS LISTED: `In the past, THE TERM PITUICYTOMA WAS ALSO APPLIED TO OTHER TUMOURS in the sellar and suprasellar region, particularly granular cell tumours and pilocytic astrocytomas. PRESENTLY, IT IS RESERVED FOR low-grade glial neoplasms that originate in the neurohypophysis ... LESS PREFERRED TERMS for pituicytoma include `POSTERIOR PITUITARY ASTROCYTOMA` and ... `INFUNDIBULOMA`.` Our `alternatives` layer again, in a real classification, with a preference order
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND A PREFIX IS ADDED BECAUSE ANOTHER FIELD USES THE SAME NAME**: the previous edition's `SUPRATENTORIAL PRIMITIVE NEUROECTODERMAL TUMOURS` becomes the more general PNET, and then `Since this designation is ALSO USED FOR similar ... tumours AT EXTRACEREBRAL SITES, the WHO Working Group PROPOSES TO ADD THE PREFIX CNS to these entities, IN ORDER TO AVOID ANY CONFUSION.` A name disambiguated by construction rather than by context
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE GRADING SCHEME DISCLAIMS ITSELF AND IS OPTIONAL**: `The WHO classification ... includes a grading scheme that is A `MALIGNANCY SCALE` RANGING ACROSS A WIDE VARIETY OF NEOPLASMS RATHER THAN A STRICT HISTOLOGICAL GRADING SYSTEM. It is widely used, BUT NOT A REQUIREMENT FOR THE APPLICATION OF THE WHO CLASSIFICATION.` The instrument that decides radiation and chemotherapy is declared not to be part of the classification it accompanies
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND ONE GRADE LABEL SPANS UNDER A YEAR AND OVER 80% FIVE-YEAR SURVIVAL**: `The majority of glioblastoma patients ... SUCCUMB TO THE DISEASE WITHIN A YEAR. For those with OTHER GRADE IV NEOPLASMS, THE OUTLOOK MAY BE CONSIDERABLY BETTER. For example, cerebellar medulloblastomas and germ cell tumours such as germinomas, BOTH WHO GRADE IV LESIONS, are rapidly fatal if untreated, while state-of-the-art radiation and chemotherapy result in 5-YEAR SURVIVAL RATES EXCEEDING 60 AND 80%.` **A class whose members are not alike in the thing the class predicts**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE GRADES OF THE NEW ENTITIES ARE PROVISIONAL BECAUSE n IS SMALL: `since THE NUMBER OF CASES of some newly defined entities IS LIMITED, THE ASSIGNMENT OF GRADES REMAINS PRELIMINARY, pending publication of additional data and long-term follow-up.` Angiocentric glioma rests on 28 reported cases, RGNT on 17, spindle cell oncocytoma on ten from three institutions - and the grade decides the therapy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND TWO GRADING SYSTEMS USE ONE NUMBER FOR DIFFERENT THINGS: `This system is similar to the St Anne/Mayo classification, WITH THE ONLY MAJOR DIFFERENCE BEING GRADE I; in the WHO system, GRADE I IS ASSIGNED TO THE MORE CIRCUMSCRIBED PILOCYTIC ASTROCYTOMA, WHEREAS the St Anne/Mayo classification ASSIGNS GRADE 1 TO AN EXCEEDINGLY RARE DIFFUSE ASTROCYTOMA WITHOUT ATYPIA.` Same label, different extension, and both live in the same clinics
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE CRITERION FOR THE TOP GRADE VARIES BY AUTHOR: `For WHO grade IV, SOME AUTHORS ACCEPT ONLY THE CRITERION OF ENDOTHELIAL PROLIFERATION, i.e. an apparent multi-layering of endothelium. THE WHO CLASSIFICATION ALSO ACCEPTS GLOMERULOID MICROVASCULAR PROLIFERATIONS. NECROSIS MAY BE OF ANY TYPE; PERINECROTIC PALISADING NEED NOT BE PRESENT.` The classification is more permissive than some of its users, and says which way
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **TWO DISTINCT ENTITIES SHARE ONE CODE, SO THE REGISTRY CANNOT SEE WHAT THE CLASSIFICATION DISTINGUISHES**: `the rosette-forming glioneuronal tumour (RGNT) corresponds to WHO grade I. IT SHARES THE NEW ICD-O CODE 9509/1 WITH THE PAPILLARY GLIONEURONAL TUMOUR (PGNT).` Anaplastic and large cell medulloblastoma likewise share 9474/3. The paper says ICD-O `ASSURES THAT HISTOPATHOLOGICALLY STRATIFIED POPULATION-BASED INCIDENCE AND MORTALITY DATA BECOME AVAILABLE` - **and the stratification stops one level above the entities the same paper just created**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A PATTERN IS NOT A VARIANT, WHICH LEAVES REAL DIFFERENCES UNNAMED: `Surgical pathologists NEED TO KNOW SUCH DIVERGENT PATTERNS of differentiation BUT NOT EVERY PATTERN WARRANTS DESIGNATION AS A VARIANT, since some patterns DO NOT HAVE DISTINCT CLINICAL OR GENETIC FEATURES.` The rank is decided by consequence, not by appearance - so a reliably recognisable thing can have no name in the system
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE WORKING GROUP IS ONE MEETING: `a group of 25 PATHOLOGISTS AND GENETICISTS CONVENED at the German Cancer Research Center in Heidelberg IN NOVEMBER 2006 and the results of their deliberations and those of AN ADDITIONAL 50 CONTRIBUTORS are contained in the 2007 WHO classification.` No voting rule, no agreement threshold and no dissent count is reported - against bishop2017 and staab2017, which publish all three
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE NEW-VARIANT RULE IS LOOSER IN THE ABSTRACT THAN IN THE TEXT: the abstract says `HISTOLOGICAL VARIANTS WERE ADDED IF THERE WAS EVIDENCE OF A DIFFERENT AGE DISTRIBUTION, LOCATION, GENETIC PROFILE OR CLINICAL BEHAVIOUR` - four alternatives joined by OR - while the Entities section requires a new ENTITY to have distinctive morphology AND location AND age distribution AND biologic behaviour. **The conjunction changes between the two statements of the same rule family**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE SHARED-CODE ACT IS PERFORMED THREE TIMES IN THIS PAPER AND THE CORPUS RECORDED IT ONCE.** Already tagged: RGNT `SHARES THE NEW ICD-O CODE 9509/1 WITH THE PAPILLARY GLIONEURONAL TUMOUR`. Also in the text, untagged until now: `the 2007 WHO classification recommends the term `EXTRAVENTRICULAR NEUROCYTOMA` AND PROPOSES AN ICD-O CODE IDENTICAL TO THAT OF CENTRAL NEUROCYTOMA (9506/1)`. **The existing tag says `TWO DISTINCT ENTITIES SHARE ONE CODE, SO THE REGISTRY CANNOT SEE WHAT THE CLASSIFICATION DISTINGUISHES` - that sentence is equally true of 9506/1, and one instance made a policy look like a slip.** Found by CLAUDE_B, 2026-08-23 15:09
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `variant` - reliably identifiable histologically and with some relevance for clinical outcome, but STILL PART OF a previously defined overarching entity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `pattern of differentiation` - an identifiable histological appearance WITHOUT distinct clinical or pathological significance; the rank for things that look different and do not behave differently
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Quotation withheld` **The rank is defined by containment, not by resemblance** - and the paper then demotes medullomyoblastoma out of entityhood and parks small cell glioblastoma below varianthood, so all three ranks are exercised in one document
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a new entity —distinct-from→ an unusual histopathological pattern
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `a new entity had to be characterized by DISTINCTIVE MORPHOLOGY, LOCATION, AGE DISTRIBUTION AND BIOLOGIC BEHAVIOUR, AND NOT SIMPLY BY AN UNUSUAL HISTOPATHOLOGICAL PATTERN.` **A published statement of what does NOT count**, which the corpus has only in the ENCODE blacklist and in bishop2017's exclusionary-criteria section. Note the conjunction: the abstract's rule for VARIANTS uses OR across the same four properties, and this rule for ENTITIES uses AND
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

IN ORDER TO AVOID ANY CONFUSION.` **A rename that changes nothing about the object and everything about the reader** - and the old name keeps the code

WITHIN A YEAR` and `5-YEAR SURVIVAL RATES EXCEEDING 60 AND 80%`. **The scale is monotone until its last step, where it stops being a scale at all**
span.term: a label that predicts opposite outcomes inside itself

span.label: the property that decides rank at every level - it separates an entity from a pattern, a variant from a pattern, and it is what a grade is meant to predict. **And it is the one property that cannot be read off the slide**, which is why two of the new categories are parked pending clinical follow-up
